notes.title: AC Black Flag Resynced Title Update 1.0.8 - Patch Notes

items.text: Hello everyone,

The game has been out for a couple of months now and it’s been an absolute pleasure for us to watch you all sail through the Caribbean once more. A sincere thank you for all the love you have shown for the game.

Tomorrow, October 27th, we're pleased to release the final major content update for Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced, available @ 14:00 UTC / 10:00 AM ET / 7:00 AM PT on all platforms. The team will follow-up with quality-of-life updates over the coming months.
Thank you to everyone who has taken the time to report issues to us via the Bug reporter. As always, you can contact our support team if you run into any trouble.
Xbox Series X|S: 15.5 GB
PlayStation®5: 4.5 GB
PC: 4.3 GB
Steam: 2.1 GB
Set Sail Again (& Again & Again & Again & Again)

Explore the Caribbean again, again, and again. New Game+ is finally here, leap back into Edward Kenway's legendary journey, explore the open seas, and rebuild your crew while keeping what you’ve earned!
All of Edward’s tools, upgrades, unlocked weapons, and trinkets.
All the Jackdaw’s upgrades, unlocked officer abilities and pets.
Officers will not physically be on ship and need to be recruited again
All money, materials and trade goods from inventory.
There is a new currency used for NG+
Quest-related items will be removed
All unlocked customizable outfits and their options.
Hideout progression, perks, and art collection.
All Kenway fleet ships.
However, forts will need to be taken over again as the map's fog will be reset.
Codex items including each treasure map, acquired and completed.
Items purchased from the store.

With each New Game+ playthrough, the seas become more dangerous. Elite Soldiers will appear more often, and max rank ships will start patrolling the waters. The difficulty ramps up each time you dive back in. You’ll be able to go up to New Game+++++ (that’s five times).

We’ve also added a new currency exclusive to New Game+ playthroughs, that you’ll be able to accumulate by completing challenges and looting previously completed chests. You’ll also be able to exchange Reales for Escudos at the General Store. You’ll be able to purchase new outfits and items exclusive to New Game+ using Escudos. Anything that was previously purchasable with Reales remains unchanged and can still be purchased at the same vendor for the same cost.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46094181/d63705d645d4ded20aa84f3e1eeec0da71309d5c.png"]

No second chances. No mercy. Nightmare Mode transforms Black Flag Resynced into a brutal fight for survival where every duel can be your last. Enemies react faster, hit harder, and punish hesitation. The Caribbean is as beautiful as ever, but beneath the waves and beyond the horizon, death awaits the unprepared.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46094181/1a2dc627686155c7a0ac7e8f828d822f9d8e3890.png"]
Enemies do 1.8x damage
The timing for parrying is reduced
No more white glint on enemy attacks
Ranged enemies shoot more often
The one-shot kill safety is disabled.
This is the most impactful since the game does not prevent an instant death, even if the player has a lot of health left. Players should be extremely mindful of bullets and explosives.
Detection time greatly reduced
Investigation time extended
Enemies can hear the player when they’re moving faster than a walk
Edward needs to be at least 6m above an enemy to stay hidden in a high spot, instead of just 4m
All ship damages are increased
Underwater sharks deal more damage
Urchins and jellyfish damage is doubled
Oxygen meter depletes faster
All harpooning wildlife deals more damage
We’ve hidden new community chests for you to find, some with special community requested rewards.
Since you’re all excellent detectives, we’ve made these ones more challenging and won’t be giving you any easy hints. Good luck Pirates.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46094181/4b7b2519dfaf75f2b4e3f8c088561e239bfa5e6a.jpg"]
We have brought back takedown animations from the original game, including hidden blade, unarmed, single sword and gunblade takedowns.
As we mentioned above, there are a bunch of new cosmetic items in this update. Ranging from outfits to new Pet skins and trinkets, collect them all by playing through New Game+.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46094181/7ce8c41aba04487e67cc804a111f31413501351c.jpg"]

Thank you for your support, fan art, videos and millions of photos shared in Photo Mode. It was a real honor to bring back Edward’s legacy to life, and to see that same excitement find its echo amongst you throughout the year.
Fixed an issue where Players were unable to launch the game in Offline Mode if connection to servers was lost whilst playing.
Increased number of Rogue Waves happening during storms.
Fixed an issue where Players owning the Deluxe edition did not have the Blackbeard items displayed as ‘Owned’ in the Exchange.
Fixed an issue where Players were able to Fast Travel to unsynchronized viewpoints in Havana and Long Bay.
Fixed an issue where the Game would freeze while playing ‘Nine-Man Morris, Checkers or Fanorona’ at a Tavern.
Fixed an issue where Camera Field of View was permanently altered indoors after experiencing ‘Delirium’.
Fixed an issue where Pistol ‘Customize’ did not affect the pistols on Edward’s hips.
Fixed an issue where the Rope Dart was still attached to Edward’s hand in the following cutscenes after assassinating a ‘Boss’ with it.
Fixed an issue where the Merlion trinket’s healing effect was still active even after quitting to memories.
Fixed multiple world map location icons that were not updated when all activities were completed.
General spelling and punctuation fixes.
Fixed some Accessibility Narration issues.
Fixed an issue where Edward could get stuck in an aiming position if he got hit while taking corner cover and aiming with a smoke bomb.
Fixed an issue where Edward was unable to assassinate sleeping casualties if they collapsed onto a bush hiding spot.
Fixed minor issues experienced while fighting and assassinating.
Fixed quality of life issues while handling tools.
Fixed an issue where Players were unable to raise to travel sails after certain quests.
Fixed an issue where the chest icon might remain visible after clearing the San Ignacio wreck.
Fixed wrong location for Capuchin Monkey’s Codex entry.
Fixed an issue where the World map could be grayed out and locked controls for a while.
Fixed an issue where hidden gear will still appear in the pause menu.
Fixed an issue where the Jackdaw might remain looking damaged despite repairing the ship.
Fixed general issues where Enemies would snap to their feet if Edward assassinated them while they slept.
Improved stability.
Fixed an issue where the Gunshots were muffled after exiting inventory and activating the ‘Blades of the Damned’ sword perk.
Fixed some gunshot sounds that were silent.
Fixed an issue for Mouse and Keyboard where the Player was unable to dive underwater if they changed the ‘Walk’ input from ‘Hold’ to ‘Toggle’.
“This Tyro Captain”: Fixed an issue where some Players could be soft locked after skinning the Ocelots.
“The Traveling Salesman”: Fixed an issue where the quest might disappear after retrieving documents from Prin’s courtyard.
“We Demand a Parley”: Fixed an issue where Rogers might die of mysterious circumstances, preventing you from fully tailing him.
“Commodore Eighty-Sixed”: Fixed an issue where the Player was unable to proceed if they managed to berserk dart the Commodore before the fight begins.
“Captain Stede Bonnet”: Fixed an issue where the Loyalists would not move if Edward took an alternative route.
“A World Without Gold: Not Even a Real Captain”: Fixed an issue where Players were unable to loot dead enemies and get stuck at 2/3 Intel.
“Officer Quest: The One with the Gun”: Fixed an issue where the plantain is missing if the player started “A World Without Gold” at the same time.
“Templar Hunt: Anto – Under Attack”: Fixed an issue where Players are unable to continue the mission if the final enemy wave does not spawn.
“Templar Hunt: Rhona – A Thief in the Market”: Fixed an issue where the Player was unable to move if they stood at a specific spot in a crowd during “Locate a hiding spot in the market”.
“Naval Contract: Realities of War”: Fixed multiple issues where the Contract giver was missing, or the contract could not be completed.
“Naval Contract: Hunter Gatherer”: Fixed an issue where the quest icon and objectives were missing after entering the mission area.
“Rift: Edward’s Memories”: Fixed parkouring issues in the spiked tunnel if You chose not to obey EGO and wait.

notes.title: AC Black Flag Resynced Title Update 1.0.7 – Patch Notes

items.text: Hello everyone,
Tomorrow, September 1st, we will be releasing the Title Update 1.0.7 for Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced @ 14:00 UTC / 10:00 AM EST / 7:00 AM PST.
Want to discuss the Title Update with your fellow community members?
Thank you to everyone who has taken the time to report issues to us via the Bug reporter. As always, you can contact our support team if you run into any trouble.
Xbox Series X|S: 15.26 GB
PlayStation®5: 1.53 GB
PC (UbiConnect): 3.86 GB
PC (Steam): 2 GB
Edward’s Pistols can now be hidden (too)!
On top of hiding the blowpipe, we have now given the option to hide Pistols as well!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46094181/af740d480f3e720000eb76a4e9929d1846cc2f5a.png"]
An example of how to hide the ‘Pistols’ in the menu.

notes.title: Perk visual effects are also going into hiding

items.text: Trinkets and their perks are great, but their glow can really make Edward stand out. You can now disable any unwanted visual perk effects.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46094181/42dc603e61404925c2f7f0304a3bd1657d03c21b.png"]
An example of turning off ‘Perk Effects’ in the menu.
Some new furry friends
Word has it there’s a furry friend in need of rescuing, somewhere across the Caribbean. Make sure you give him a good pet when you find him, because he may just join you at the ‘Hideout’ later.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46094181/de20e0b4f936f91db999bf1f9fe5137074d0e0b0.jpg"]
General
Fixed an issue where incapacitated ships could be sunk after coming out of a harpooning activity.
Fixed an issue where Players could fall through the world when Fast travelling to Principe.
Fixed an issue where the region is not revealed after completing the respective fort and synchronizing 100%.
Fixed an issue where target ships could spawn outside of the map during various quests.
Fixed an issue where Enemies could not be marked in Eagle Vision if health bars were disabled in HUD.
Fixed an issue where Edward would not remain in crouched position during stealth after exiting Photo mode.
Fixed an issue where the Padre’s Questline vanished after changing graphics settings.
And many more!
Fixed an issue where Barrels detonated by pistol during Boarding did not lower morale.
Fixed an issue with Diabolist’s Pistol where Edward was unable to perform a Takedown when Enemies were in suspicious state while on fire.
Fixed an issue where Edward was unable to assassinate Enemies investigating the haystack Edward was hiding in.
Fixed an issue where wildlife could be possessed when shot with the Gargoyle’s Breath Pistol.
Fixed an issue where Edward could be frozen mid-air during an air assassination if the target is killed by someone else first.
Fixed an issue where Edward could be damaged from nearby barrels despite hiding while hanging on the wall.
Fixed multiple issues during Boarding where Edward could be ignored by Enemies after landing on deck.
Fixed an issue where the Padre may be compelled to not follow Edward into a Fort raid.
Fixed multiple issues where Enemies could rise from the dead after throwing a smoke bomb at them.
Fixed some issues with Enemy ships spawning out of nowhere and causing other ships to behave erratically.
Fixed an issue where Edward could be killed while playing a mini game just because there is a dead body nearby.
Fixed a minor issue where Edward could be stuck in a loop of breaking down a Fort’s War Room Door, forced to live through the same loop over and over and over again…
Fixed an issue where animals could behave erratically after interaction.
UI/Menu
Fixed an issue where multiple world map icons weren’t updated when all activities were completed.Fixed an issue where Players could spyglass the HMS Prince beyond 500m while in a fog.
Fixed issues with Photo mode when HUD background was turned on.
Visuals & Graphics
Fixed animation issue where Edward’s hands were not in sync with the wheel after a Fort takeover.
Fixed minor animation issues pertaining to parkour and assassination.
Fixed an issue where the lift on ships glowed brighter than the sun after using Eagle Vision.
Fixed an issue where the Blowpipe might appear after harpooning despite choosing to hide it.
Fixed various graphical loading issues.
Stability & Optimizations
Fixed occasional crashes that were happening when opening the Store or News panel.
Fixed some crashes happening when selecting ships on Kenway’s Fleet selection menu.
Fixed a rare crash on PS5 when Players entered the Out of Bounds.
Fixed other minor issues possibly occurring around the game.
Fixed multiple missing sound effects issues. Some sound effects escaped their chambers and have been escorted back to where they belong.
Save / Load
Fixed an issue where certain music is not played after loading a save file.
Fixed an issue where Stede Bonnet was missing when Players loaded a previous save file before purchasing the British cutlasses.
Accessibility
Fixed multiple color-blindness issues for Red-Green or Blue-Yellow preset settings.
Fixed missing Menu Narrations.
Fixed missing Gameplay captions.
Platform Specific
Fixed an issue when turning HDR ‘on’ could cause a black screen on Steam Deck.
Quests
"Wayward Souls Rift": Fixed an issue where the jellyfish walls had visibility loading issues.
"Upton Travers": Fixed an issue where the British guards would not interact with Upton unless Edward was next to them.
"Upton Travers": Fixed an issue where the British guards would attack Edward if he was “blended in”.
"Right-Hand Man": Fixed the exploit where Players could complete the objective without doing anything.
"Everything is permitted": Fixed an issue where Ah Tabai may freeze if Edward assassinates his target before him. Ah Tabai will no longer be stun locked if Edward kill steals his target.
"The Sage's buried secret": Fixed an issue where James Kidd could be stuck if Edward navigates ahead of him.
“The Final Contract”: Fixed an issue where the Player could attack ‘The Hollander’ ally ship.
“A Proper Shipwright”: Fixed an issue where one of the British Fleet’s ships appears out of bounds.
“Vainglorious Bastards”: Fixed the issue where waterspouts kept killing Charles Vane and his ship.

items.text: Hello everyone,

notes.title: The Blowpipe Can Now Be Hidden

items.text: We saw your feedback, and we have given players the option to hide the “Blow Pipe” from Edward’s back. In order to do so, access your outfit in the inventory and select R2 for the option to “Hide Gear”. Or “Show Gear” if you’d prefer the “Blow Pipe” be visible on certain outfits.
An example of how to hide the Blowpipe in the menu.
Increased number of autosaves from 5 to 10 to allow players to load from earlier progressions.

Added missing tutorial on how to ‘Throw Money’.

Fixed an issue on PC for Mouse & Keyboard where Quest icon could be marked/unmarked when selecting the Quest tab.

Fixed an issue where the Naval Convoy’s leader could go flying after lowering wanted level or sending it to Kenway’s fleet during Boarding.
Fixed an issue where players may get stuck when attempting to parkour between a tree and a wall in Kingston.
Fixed an issue where players could ‘Fast Travel’ to an unsynchronized viewpoint in Havana.

Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in free fall when climbing behind the chest at Mariguana Island.

releases.displayName: Known issue update: cutscenes on PC locked to 30 FPS (workaround)

items.text: Hello Assassins,
We are aware that there is an issue where cutscenes on PC are locked to 30 FPS when using Raytracing, BVH or Terrain Quality at Ultra High setting.

We have a fix coming soon, but in the meantime, we've provided a temporary workaround: Reset the graphics Overall Preset to any pre-configured setting and avoid manually setting Raytracing, BVH or Terrain Quality to the Ultra High setting.
